artifact.digest_scope: Canonical source, license, reference, cases, and historical review. This review record is excluded.

decision_question: Can the canonical package publish the recruiter reconciliation, source recovery, event timing, and audience safeguards as reviewed portable source?

Protect private locators and distinguish analytical evidence

source_basis.source: Owner-authorized private workflow, distilled into synthetic cases.

Canonical package and six baseline cases.

source_basis.source: Skillz Equilibrium Review 1.0.1 and Skill Foundry 3.1.1

shared_model_or_source_limits: Agent reviewers used a shared model family and the same sanitized review packet.
Review was static. Reviewers made no host or application writes.

initial_reviews.finding: Supply exact receipt dates and observed artifact facts. Keep source validity separate from host claims.
Make check-only behavior explicit and preserve per-source coverage after blocked reads.
Require a write-time guard for one-field updates. Scope disclosure to each destination audience and deny embedded authorization.

falsification_hypotheses: A past interview could be reported as future without an as-of clock.
A notice with an older event date could arrive after the last source cutoff and be missed.
A shared report could reveal a private evidence link.
test_results: The interview-replacement case fixes the review clock before the replacement event and tests RSVP separately from attendance.
The restore-source case distinguishes October 12 tracker arrival from October 9 effective time and uses the tracker-specific cutoff.
The private-locator case permits sanitized source type and date and requires withholding the private locator.

decisive_evidence: Reviewed the canonical 1.1.0 integration after the 1.0.0 merge and verified its digest.
Final packaging clarifies fixture capability assumptions and normalizes the existing MIT license line endings. Procedure text remains byte-identical to the negotiated candidate.

limitations: Analytical source release only. No live baseline, automatic activation, protected holdout, or connector acceptance was run.
The original 1.0.0 review remains historical for the 1.1.0 procedure.

follow_up.condition: Before claiming behavioral or host readiness
follow_up.action: Freeze an external unseen holdout and validate host authorization, concurrency, coverage, and readback against exact package bytes.
